name: Hold Up narrator
note: The channel's default narrator. Stories without their own voice use this profile once it is approved. It stays unselected until the owner listens to the auditions and picks one (node tools/narration/audition.mjs select <n> --by "<name>").

target.summary: An entertaining person telling an incredible story to a friend.
want: slightly sarcastic or amused when it fits
shifts between suspense, humour and surprise
